terms.title: Initial setup: encryption key
terms.what: To build a drive the XDJ-RX3 runs, the toolkit needs the key the player uses for maintenance mode. That key is in the source package Pioneer DJ publishes on its GPL page. If you continue, the toolkit downloads that package (about 250 MB) directly from Pioneer's servers, checks the fingerprint of every file, keeps only the key in this computer's application folder, and deletes the rest.
terms.nothingElse: Nothing is sent anywhere else. The toolkit does not contain the key, and its authors do not distribute it.
terms.purpose: Use the key only to make an XDJ-RX3 you own run software you choose. Do not share it, publish it, or use it on equipment that is not yours.
terms.owner: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Pioneer DJ or AlphaTheta. The package, its contents and the key remain theirs. Downloading them gives you no rights beyond those their licences and your local law grant.
terms.law: Whether obtaining and using this key is lawful depends on where you live. Checking that is your responsibility, as is what you do with the key.
terms.risk: Running modified software on a player may affect its warranty and can make it crash, including during a performance. The toolkit is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
terms.remove: You can delete the key at any time with Delete the key, under Modules, or by removing the XDJ-RX3 Toolkit folder from your application data.
terms.scroll: Scroll to the end of the terms to enable the “I have read and accept these terms” checkbox.
terms.accept: I have read and accept these terms

tutorial.title: Using XDJ-RX3 Toolkit
tutorial.intro: Choose a topic for step-by-step instructions and player demonstrations.
tutorial.usb: Export your rekordbox playlists to your USB drive. Wait for the export to finish, then close rekordbox. Use the USB drive control at the bottom left to choose that drive: select its name without opening a folder inside it. You can check the music, modules and sample banks it contains there.
tutorial.modules: In Modules, select the features you want. Required modules are selected automatically. The switches set up your selection; they do not save it to the USB drive yet. Then click Install the mod.
tutorial.installTitle: 3. Install the mod on the USB drive
tutorial.key: Open Install the mod, review your selection and choose the destination. On first installation, the app asks you to read and accept the terms before retrieving the required file.
tutorial.install: After initial setup, check the destination, then confirm with Install the mod. Wait for installation to finish. If you change USB drives, check the installation destination and the stems destination again.
tutorial.stems: In Stems, open your USB drive or rekordbox XML, then choose a playlist, stems and quality. The files and their waveforms will be prepared on the selected USB drive. In Preview, choose a track to listen to its stems and seek within the track.
tutorial.import: Already separated your tracks in another app? Use Import existing stems: choose the original track, then match the vocal file and, if available, the drums file. Run the import, then listen to the result.
tutorial.samples: In Samples, create your banks and add sounds to the pads. Set the excerpt, playback mode and level, then switch to Play pads to try them. Your work is saved automatically in the app. Choose the active bank and click “Save to USB drive” when you have finished. Also install the Samples module on that drive.
tutorial.logo: In Logo, choose an image and adjust its framing. The Logo module turns on automatically. Use the light or dark background to check the result before installation.
tutorial.settings: Settings changes the Toolkit language and appearance on this computer. To change the player display, select the Light theme module in Modules.

tutorial.subject: Tutorial topic
tutorial.startUsb: Export your rekordbox playlists to your USB drive. Wait for the export to finish, close rekordbox, then select the drive at the bottom of the sidebar.
tutorial.startModules: In Modules, select the functions you want and adjust their settings.
tutorial.startAssets: For a custom logo, choose your image in Logo before installation. You can also prepare samples and stems in their own screens.
tutorial.startInstall: Open Install the mod. Check the recap and destination, then follow the steps until installation completes. On first use, the app presents the terms for the required download.
tutorial.sampleCreate: Create your banks and switch between them: your samples and settings are saved automatically in the app.
tutorial.sampleEdit: In Edit pads, choose a pad and add a sound. Set the excerpt, level and playback mode. Try it in Play pads.
tutorial.sampleSave: Choose the active bank, then click “Save to USB drive” to send all your changes. To play samples on the RX3, install the Samples module on that drive.
tutorial.stemSource: Select your USB drive, then open Stems. Choose your USB export or Open Rekordbox Library XML export, and select a playlist.
tutorial.stemPrepare: Choose the stems and their quality, then start preparation. The files and their waveforms are saved to the selected drive. Also install the Stems module on that drive.
tutorial.stemPreview: In Preview, choose a track. Once it loads, use Play/Pause, turn stems on or off, and click the waveform to seek.
tutorial.harmonicHelp: Enhanced Key Match adds harmonic matches in BROWSE alongside the RX3’s native matches.
tutorial.logoChoose: Choose an image in Logo. The Logo module turns on automatically.
tutorial.logoFrame: Adjust the framing in the preview and check it against light and dark backgrounds.
tutorial.logoInstall: Open Install the mod and confirm installation to save your logo to the USB drive.

keyShiftAccess.label: RX3 screen: KEY tab and pitch shifting on both decks.
keyShiftAccess.touchStep0: Tap KEY to show the key controls for both decks.
keyShiftAccess.touchStep1: Each deck has −1, the current key in the centre and +1. Manual shifting ranges from −12 to +12 semitones.
keyShiftAccess.touchStep2: On deck 2, +1 shifts 8A to 3A. The offset appears beside the key: 3A (+1).
keyShiftAccess.touchStep3: Tap the key in the centre to restore the original key: 8A.
keyShiftAccess.touchStep4: Tap KEY again to restore the display for the selected pad mode.
keySyncAccess.label: RX3 screen: Key Shift and Key Sync on each deck, with deck 1 as MASTER.
keySyncAccess.touchStep0: Tap KEY. The MASTER deck supplies the reference key.
keySyncAccess.touchStep1: KEY SYNC shows the proposed shift for your mode, range and harmonic rules. NO SYNC means no target is available.
keySyncAccess.touchStep2: Tap KEY SYNC when a shift is proposed: deck 2 is transposed and its centre key updates.
keySyncAccess.touchStep3: KEY MATCH indicates harmonic compatibility; IDENTIQUE indicates the same key in identical mode. These are statuses, not buttons.
keySyncAccess.touchStep4: Tap KEY again to restore the display for the selected pad mode. The shift is retained.
